mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, with tamoxifen requiring CYP2D6 metabolism for conversion to active metabolite endoxifen, and prochlorperazine competing for hepatic metabolism; additive anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects also possible.
action: Monitor tamoxifen efficacy and consider alternative antiemetic; if combination necessary, ensure adequate CYP2D6 activity and assess for CNS/anticholinergic side effects.
